question: Why is Śiva alone the true knower without other means of knowledge?
premises: Śiva is all-powerful and the sole knower.
This entire knowable world is his own limb.
Other ostentatious means of knowledge are unnecessary.
inference: Because the whole field of knowledge is Śiva's own manifestation, he alone is the self-sufficient knower.
plain_english: He alone is all-powerful; what need is there of other displays of means of knowledge? Śiva alone is the one knower, whose own limb this world appears as such.
